content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A function is a typed boundary: values go in, a value comes out.
**Senior habit:** Make important function boundaries obvious. That is where type information pays for itself repeatedly.
nextSteps: Write a typed function `isAdult(age)` that accepts a number and returns a boolean.
